records.text: On the same Fock and Weyl/vacuum pair, the positive exponential lift G is self-adjoint and S=JG. The maximal antilinear adjoint and the genuine two-application domain identify Delta=G squared=S-dagger S. Independent root reconstruction covers the bounded tensor/Gamma infrastructure and concrete polar factor. The actual Tomita square is positive self-adjoint; its regularized graph and spectral imaginary-power unitary group are constructed. The latter is strongly continuous and gives a PairTomita realization for that CFC flow. On H1 the actual resolvent of TW squared and its spectral flow are identified with B0(-2*pi*t). Equality to Gamma(B0) on the full Fock and KMS remain open. J R(KWR) J equals R(KWR-prime), and these algebras commute. The concrete standard wedge is nonisotropic and its Weyl algebra is nonabelian. Full commutant equality is not asserted. Positive energy is now a theorem for the same Fock: the actual orbital contraction is lifted sectorwise and analyticity extends from the total exponential family by uniform coefficient bounds. Its real boundary is the original Gamma(U1). No Fock analyticity premise is imported. The dual weight on the actual Fock regular core is faithful. A concrete averaged element has quadratic weight exactly one, and the finite-weight ideal is strongly dense. The full scalar finite-weight left ideal and dual invariance have also been constructed. A typed nonzero witness rules out using this invariant weight itself as the exp(-s)-scaled trace; the distinct perturbed trace remains open. The additive NetworkPositiveCore adapter has 24 explicit remaining fields. Nonabelianity and positive energy are supplied by actual theorems. The global CanonicalNetInput and the whole remaining record have no exhibited joint inhabitant; this is a field count, not a count of independent mathematical problems.
